note: Web searches of 19/11/2026 for the 23 distinct places of the run-002 dossiers (all of them: after the protocol v3 rules no dossier is settled by the data alone). Findings are summaries of the search results; links are the sources returned. A match (true) needs a source describing the relief of the place itself, or of an area that names it, as dissected hills or stepped slopes, the relief the target's slope profile describes; regional descriptions alone give no match (null), as in run-001. A match is my judgement. No finding was used to rank or remove a zone.

searches.query: Walla Walla County Touchet Blue Mountains foothills terrain canyons slopes geology
searches.finding: Walla Walla basin between the Blue Mountains and the Columbia Plateau: canyons in the mountains, alluvial fans and terraces below, rolling lower reaches. No source describes the zone itself.

searches.query: Ibertioga São Tiago Andrelândia Minas Gerais relevo "mar de morros" serras quartzito
searches.finding: A thesis on the Andrelândia area: predominant 'mar de morros' relief, an advanced stage of dissection with hills cut by valleys; Andrelândia Group quartzites give cuesta relief.

searches.place: -21.46,-43.99 / -20.81,-44.48 / -21.64,-44.12 / -21.13,-44.48 (Ibertioga, São Tiago, Santana do Garambéu, Conceição da Barra de Minas, Minas Gerais)
searches.query: Ibertioga São Tiago Andrelândia Minas Gerais relevo "mar de morros" serras quartzito
searches.finding: Only regional descriptions (Alto Rio Grande plateau: rounded hills, quartzite ridges above 1,400 m); nothing names these municipalities.

searches.query: Piedade dos Gerais Minas Gerais relevo serras morros geologia
searches.finding: Nothing on the municipality; results are about the Serra da Piedade, another range, and Minas Gerais relief in general.

searches.query: Custer County Nebraska loess canyons terrain Middle Loup dissected hills
searches.finding: Central Nebraska Loess Hills, cut by the Loup rivers; the steepest ecological site (Loess Breaks) has slopes above 30%. The pits profile is gentle (median 3.7°): the description does not match it.

searches.query: Kaldar district Balkh Afghanistan terrain sand dunes Amu Darya relief
searches.finding: District on the Amu Darya floodplain; north Afghanistan has sand drifts, dunes and loess in general. Nothing on the relief of the zone.

searches.query: Mbhashe Eastern Cape topography deeply incised valleys rolling hills Transkei relief
searches.finding: Former Transkei: rolling hills with deeply incised river valleys; the Mbhashe river crosses a plateau, then incised valleys. Regional, not the zone.

searches.query: Chone Manabí Ecuador relieve colinas cordillera costera pendientes
searches.finding: Canton surrounded by hills and small coastal ranges above 100 m (source of variable quality). No slope data for the zone.

searches.query: Penzhinsky district Kamchatka 64°N 166°E relief mountains Penzhina river topography
searches.finding: District between the Penzhina range and the Parapolsky Dol plain; no relief description of the zone.

searches.query: Kwilu province DRC relief plateaux dissected valleys Kwango plateau topography
searches.finding: Kwango-Kwilu: plateaus cut by entrenched valleys with steep edges and landslides (regional studies, mostly student work). Nothing on the zone.

searches.query: Lafaiete Coutinho Bahia relevo geomorfologia serras colinas
searches.finding: Nothing on the municipality; the Depressão Sertaneja Meridional has serras, hills and steps on crystalline basement (regional).

searches.query: Saboia Odemira serra relevo xisto vales encaixados Baixo Alentejo
searches.finding: Only a tourism blog places Saboia in the mountainous Serra de Monchique area; no geological or relief source on the zone.

searches.query: Bétaré-Oya Cameroun relief géomorphologie collines Lom
searches.finding: Old ORSTOM geology: the Lom valley is the only notable relief, with schist hills along a mining track. Does not describe the pits profile (gentle slopes) or the zone.

searches.query: Pazarcık Kahramanmaraş topoğrafya jeomorfoloji dağlık engebeli arazi
searches.finding: Studies of the Gölbaşı depression and the 2023 earthquake; no relief description of the zone.

searches.query: Santa Cruz de Salinas Minas Gerais relevo chapadas vales Jequitinhonha geomorfologia
searches.finding: Jequitinhonha region: chapadas on old planation surfaces above 650 m, cut by valleys (regional). Nothing on the municipality.

searches.query: Santana Amapá relief terrain floodplain Amazon estuary topography geology
searches.finding: Amapá lowlands: flat tidal floodplains toward the Amazon, and savannas on a dissected low plateau (0 to 55 m). Which setting holds the zone is not stated; its hillshade shows low, finely dissected relief.

searches.query: Waternish Dunvegan Skye stepped basalt lava plateau trap landscape terraces
searches.finding: Gently dipping Palaeogene lavas cover most of northern Skye and give a stepped 'trap' landscape (flows of 10 to 15 m).

searches.query: Beed district Maharashtra Deccan trap plateau Balaghat range hills relief slopes
searches.finding: Deccan basalt; district units are lowland, Godavari highland, Balaghat plateau (flat-topped hills) and Sina basin. Which unit holds the zone is not stated.

searches.query: New Barag Left Banner Handagai Greater Khingan foothills terrain hills relief
searches.finding: No relief description of Handagai; the region is grassland west of the Da Hinggan range.

searches.query: Ibiquera Bahia relevo Chapada Diamantina serras geomorfologia
searches.finding: The municipality lies in the Chapada Diamantina (IBGE); the Chapada has flat-topped serras cut by narrow valleys (regional). Nothing on the zone.
